attacks.name: Metal Storm
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Rocket Pods
steps: |*Barrage|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Rocket Pods| attack. This attack must target another character within |!range| 2 of the original defender. This additional attack does not have the |*Barrage| special rule.

attacks.name: Empty the Clip
steps: When rolling additional dice for |!critical| results during this attack, roll 2 additional dice instead of 1 for each |!critical| in the attack roll.
After this attack is resolved, if the roll contains any |!critical| results, this character suffers 2 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Reload
superPowers.body: Remove up to 2 |!damage| from this character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Titanium Armor Plating
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
